name: scalar-site
description: Engenharia e Ferramentas Estáticas de Alta Performance (Scalar)

scripts.build:css: npm run precss:build && npm run css:build
scripts.dev: npm run precss:build && concurrently "npx --no-install tailwindcss -i ./assets/css/input.css -o ./assets/css/main.css --watch" "hugo server --buildDrafts --disableFastRender"
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:stats && npm run build:css && hugo --gc --minify
